import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import lightgbm as lgb


def calculate_mean_column_wise_rmsle(y_true, y_pred):
    """Calculate mean-column-wise RMSLE as per competition specification."""
    n_samples = len(y_true)
    if n_samples == 0:
        return float("nan")

    rmse_per_col = np.zeros(y_true.shape[1])
    for i in range(y_true.shape[1]):
        term = np.log(y_pred[:, i] + 1e-10) - np.log(y_true[:, i] + 1e-10)
        rmse_per_col[i] = np.sqrt(np.mean(term**2))

    return float(np.mean(rmse_per_col))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

    # Load Data
    print("Loading data...")
    train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

    if os.path.exists("input/sample_submission.csv"):
        sample_df = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")
    else:
        sample_df = None

    print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df)}, Test samples: {len(test_df)}")

    target_cols = ["formation_energy_ev_natom", "bandgap_energy_ev"]
    target_cols_exist = [col for col in target_cols if col in train_df.columns]
    print(f"Target columns found: {target_cols_exist}")

    # Get feature columns - exclude ID-like columns and targets
    exclude_cols = ["id"] + target_cols_exist
    all_features = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in exclude_cols]

    # Keep only numeric features
    feature_cols = []
    for col in all_features:
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(train_df[col]):
            feature_cols.append(col)

    print(f"Feature columns selected: {feature_cols}")

    # Prepare Training Data
    X_train = train_df[feature_cols].fillna(0).astype(float).values
    y_train = train_df[target_cols_exist].values
    X_train_id = train_df["id"].values

    # Prepare Test Data
    X_test = test_df[feature_cols].fillna(0).astype(float).values
    X_test_ids = test_df["id"].values

    # Scaling
    print("Scaling features...")
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
    X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

    # Hold-Out Validation Split (NEVER train on this)
    print("Creating validation split...")
    np.random.seed(42)

    indices = np.arange(len(X_train_scaled))
    train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(indices, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

    X_train_final = X_train_scaled[train_idx]
    y_train_final = y_train[train_idx]
    X_val = X_train_scaled[val_idx]
    y_val = y_train[val_idx]

    print(f"Train size: {len(X_train_final)}, Val size: {len(X_val)}")

    # Initialize Model
    print("Initializing LightGBM model...")
    model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(
        n_estimators=500,
        max_depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        num_leaves=31,
        min_child_samples=20,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=0.1,
        verbose=-1,
        random_state=42,
    )

    # Fit model on TRAINING DATA ONLY (not including validation rows)
    print("Fitting model...")
    model.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

    # Calculate Validation RMSLE on actual held-out data (never seen during training)
    y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
    val_score = calculate_mean_column_wise_rmsle(y_val, y_pred_val)
    print(f"\nValidation Mean Column-Wise RMSLE: {val_score:.6f}")

    # Generate Final Predictions on TRUE Test Set (unlabeled)
    print("Generating test predictions...")
    y_pred_test = model.predict(X_test_scaled)

    # Ensure output format matches sample submission template
    expected_cols = (
        sample_df.columns.tolist() if sample_df is not None else target_cols + ["id"]
    )
    print(f"Expected submission columns: {expected_cols}")

    # Construct Submission DataFrame
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "id": X_test_ids,
            "formation_energy_ev_natom": y_pred_test[:, 0],
            "bandgap_energy_ev": y_pred_test[:, 1],
        }
    )

    # Round predictions to reasonable precision to avoid floating point issues
    submission_df["formation_energy_ev_natom"] = submission_df[
        "formation_energy_ev_natom"
    ].round(6)
    submission_df["bandgap_energy_ev"] = submission_df["bandgap_energy_ev"].round(6)

    # Save submission file to REQUIRED LOCATION
    submission_df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

    print("\nSubmission saved to submission/submission.csv successfully.")
    print(f"Total submissions: {len(submission_df)}")
